question: If the ratio of the mode and median is 13 ∶ 9, then find the ratio of the mean and mode using empirical relation.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Mode = 13 and Median = 9 based on the given ratio.

Empirical formula: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

⇒ 13 = 3 × 9 − 2 × Mean

⇒ 2 × Mean = 27 − 13 = 14

⇒ Mean = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7 : 13.**
